data.rationale: Profit warning avere en 2025 : guidance GAAP diluted EPS 2025 abaissee de 4,58-4,83 $ a 4,23-4,43 $ (charges/integration, pression Oak Street Health), meme si adjusted EPS a ete releve a 6,00-6,20 $. Guidance 2026 reaffirmee ensuite (adjusted EPS 7,00-7,20 $, cash flow revise a 'au moins 9 Mds$').
